owner_rules: Done means ALL evidence: implemented as specified (task id), a test that FAILED before and passes now, suites green, measured number vs target, docs regenerated, committed AND pushed to the contract's branch.
Never defer: no "later", "follow-up", "out of scope". If blocked: what blocks, what you tried, what you need; then continue with the next task.
Root cause, then fix: file:line + mechanism. No weakening tests, raising timeouts, skips, relaxed assertions.
No silent scope cuts: never lower targets, caps or test sizes without owner approval.
Never bypass guards: no --no-verify, no bypass env vars, no skip flags.
Deliver continuously: one task per commit, pushed to the contract's branch as it goes green.
Honest reporting: TASK-ID | status | commit | tests | measured vs target | missing.

tasks.title: Decision record
requirements: Retrieval governed by identity, project membership, classification, policy and jurisdiction
Enforce identity, role, project membership, department, purpose, data classification, jurisdiction, consent and explicit resource permissions at retrieval and action time.

Apply least privilege and deny by default across organisational and federation boundaries. Do not rely on UI filtering alone; access control must be enforced by the underlying services and data paths.
Distinguish raw source records, confidential artefacts, shared summaries, metadata, derived insights and public organisational knowledge. Each may have different sharing rules.
Keep secrets, credentials, personal data and restricted material out of general organisational retrieval unless explicitly authorised and necessary for the task.
Allow administrators to define organisation-wide defaults while retaining narrower project, team, department, location and jurisdiction controls.
